rules.statement: Make session cookies host-only: give them the `__Host-` name prefix, set Secure and Path=/, and never set a `Domain` attribute.
rules.why: Tenants live on subdomains of one registrable domain, so a cookie scoped to a parent domain would be shared across tenants.
rules.check: Look for session or auth cookie options (CookieOptions, CookieAuthenticationOptions.Cookie, SessionOptions.Cookie) that set `Domain`, or whose cookie name lacks the `__Host-` prefix.

rules.statement: Name platform environments only `production`, `lab` and `ci`, and never use `dev`, `test` or `staging` for a platform environment, host, tag or root, because those words belong to customer tenants.
rules.why: Platform environment names and tenant environment names must never overlap, so conversations, support tickets and hostnames can't be misread.
rules.check: Look for new deployment config, OpenTofu or Helm values, hostnames or tags that name a platform environment `dev`, `test`, `staging`, `sandbox` or similar.

rules.statement: Keep platform DNS records DNS-only (never Cloudflare-proxied), leave Cloudflare Universal SSL off, and have CAA records allow only Let's Encrypt.
rules.why: TLS has to reach the platform's own proxy untouched, and Universal SSL would publish CAA records for Cloudflare's own CAs.
rules.check: In OpenTofu DNS resources, look for `proxied = true`, Universal SSL being turned on, or CAA records that allow CAs other than Let's Encrypt.
